evidence: Official VEX language reference: C-like compiled language with performance near C/C++, written per-context (SOPs, CHOPs, shading), with built-in geometry manipulation functions.

Official docs on Houdini Digital Assets: package node networks into reusable custom nodes with own UIs, stored in .hda library files with versioning/namespaces and source-control-friendly expanded format.

Solaris is Houdini's USD-based scene-building/lookdev context; every LOP node outputs a fully-composed USD stage and edits only land in override layers above loaded layers (non-destructive procedural USD authoring).

H20.5 release notes: Copernicus is a 2D/3D GPU image-processing framework (beta) replacing legacy COPs, with slap comp, ONNX ML inference, procedural texture/pattern generation and Vulkan geometry rasterizer interop with SOPs.
Product page confirms Copernicus shipped in beta with Houdini 20.5; targets texture-map building and slap comps with node-based noise, distortion and 3D-shape rasterization.
Houdini Engine docs: C API (HAPI) plus Python wrapper, with maintained plug-ins for Unreal, Unity, Maya and 3ds Max so HDAs cook inside host DCCs.
hapi Python package docs: Engine is a binary-compatible C API usable from managed (C#/Python) and native C++ hosts, exposing geometry setters, parms, PDG and SessionSync APIs.
Official pricing: Houdini FX $4,495 node-locked perpetual ($1,095/yr upgrade plan), floating $6,695; Houdini Indie subscription $299/yr ($449/2yr), max 3 licenses per facility.
Insomniac's David Santiago GDC 2019 postmortem on procedurally crafting Manhattan for Marvel's Spider-Man: procedural systems authored ground, buildings, traffic, crimes, props and impostors.
SideFX's GDC 2019 archive documenting that Houdini powered Insomniac's Spider-Man city pipeline plus other studio procedural talks; vendor-curated studio evidence.
Official Bifrost page: node-based visual programming graph inside Maya covering Aero/MPM/particles/BOSS sims, scattering/instancing, geometry-level nodes and non-destructive procedural USD assembly.
Bifrost plugin docs: ships as separate plug-in plus bifcmd command-line tool that executes exported Bifrost graphs headlessly; key for pipeline/batch procedural generation.
MASH procedural effects docs: node networks (Waiter hub + Distribute + Instancer/Repro) generate instanced object arrays with chainable effector nodes for motion graphics.
MASH API technical documentation: Python helper classes to automate creation and manipulation of MASH networks (createNetwork, meshDistribute, dynamics helpers).
C4D 2023 manual introducing Scene Nodes: node graphs create geometry, custom deformers and clone distributions feeding a Scene Manager; C4D's first-class procedural modeling path.
C++ SDK Nodes handbook: node framework splits into scene-node and material-node spaces; third parties can author/share custom nodes and node-space assets (cinema/graph/nodespace frameworks).
80.lv coverage of SideFX's Copernicus tutorial series: building rock/dirt/grass textures via Worley/fractal noise, AO-driven ramps, point scatter rasterization and SOP-COP interop.
80.lv reports Houdini 20.5 released with rearchitected Copernicus GPU image context (beta), showing real production-style NPR rendering test by Nordeus lead artist Nikola Damjanov.
Official API docs v3 (openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3): async task pattern, POST generation then poll /v3/tasks/{id}; covers text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging and mesh editing.
API credit pricing table: P1.0 text-to-3D 30cr untextured/40cr textured, image-to-3D 40/50cr; older V2.x models 10-30cr; surcharges for quad topology, parts, texture quality tiers.
Subscription pricing: Professional $20/mo (3,000 credits ~200 models), Max $90/mo (25,000 cr), Team $55/seat/mo; concurrency and queue priority scale with tier.
Official TripoSG repo: open weights, inference code, plus TripoSG-scribble CFG-distilled variant for fast prototyping; vendor claims output on par with commercial Tripo 2.0.
Meshy API docs: RESTful task-based API for text/image/multi-image-to-3D, texturing, remesh, rig and animation; publishes OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an MCP server for agent integration.
Official pricing: Free 100 cr/mo (CC BY 4.0 output), Pro $20/mo 1,000cr, Premium $40, Ultra $100, Studio $70/seat; API access gated to paid plans; commercial use on all paid tiers.
Credit cost table: Image-to-3D 25cr on Meshy 7 / 20cr on Meshy 6; AI texturing 10cr; remesh, rigging and animation free; Smart Topology T2 5cr vs T1 20cr.
Rodin pricing: pay-by-result model (generate free, pay on confirm); Business tier unlocks full API at 120-240 RPM, HD/custom textures, smart low-poly and baked normals.
Rodin API spec: async submit-poll-download flow; documents Rodin Gen-2 with 10B-parameter 'BANG' architecture, image-to-3D and text-to-3D modes via api.hyper3d.com/api/v2.
CLAY paper (underlying Rodin Gen-1): 1.5B-param multi-resolution VAE + latent DiT geometry generator with 3D-aware controls and multi-view material diffusion producing 2K PBR textures.
Official OpenCLAY repo links CLAY paper to commercial Rodin Gen-1 and HF demo; notes CLAY received SIGGRAPH 2024 Best Paper Honorable Mention.

Spline docs: AI 3D generation is a paid feature billed in monthly AI credits; model picker exposes Hunyuan3D (default), Hunyuan 3.1 Pro and Trellis 2; Spline orchestrates third-party engines, not its own model.
Official pricing: credit packs $10.99/mo (750cr) to $36.99/mo (3,000cr) and $15 one-time packs; text-to-3D generation costs 50 credits per model.
CG Channel launch coverage: Kaedim converts 2D concept art to low-poly OBJ/FBX/glTF; subscription $299-$7,700/mo at launch (30-1,000 models), developed with Rebellion and Aardman input.

Kaedim's own docs disclose a hybrid pipeline: ML 2D-to-3D reconstruction plus in-house artist team verifies/cleans every output ('production-ready, every time'), claiming 10x speedup vs traditional outsourcing.
Sloyd API docs: single HTTP call returns jobId, poll to GLB; supports text/image/multi-view-to-3D, retexture, split-to-parts and 360 skyboxes; topology and targetFaceCount (<=500k) controllable.
Alpha3D API reference: async job model with per-step credit costs: standard generation 30cr, PBR 42cr, low-poly 48cr, geometry-only 24cr; retopology/UV/rigging pipeline steps billed separately.
Alpha3D pricing: plans from EUR5/mo (Tester) to Enterprise; REST API and MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT included on every tier; image-gen/background-removal endpoints free but rate-limited.
Launch coverage of Luma Genie (Nov 2023): free Discord research preview returning 4 GLB drafts in ~20s with ~20min refine; positioned as a research preview ahead of paid service.
3D Arena paper: open image-to-3D evaluation platform with 123,243 pairwise human votes across 19 models including commercial SaaS, ELO-ranked with fraud-detection quality control.
CVPR 2024 GPTEval3D: GPT-4V performs criteria-based pairwise comparisons of text-to-3D outputs producing human-aligned Elo ratings; scalable eval methodology for comparing commercial generators.
